sources.entry: htop: an interactive process viewer for Linux

summary.title: htop - an interactive process viewer
summary.one_liner: htop is a cross-platform, text-mode interactive process viewer that requires ncurses and runs on Linux, BSD variants, macOS and Solaris.
keywords: how to see running processes in terminal
takeaways: htop is a text-mode interactive process viewer that needs the ncurses library.
Current releases support Linux, FreeBSD, NetBSD, OpenBSD, DragonFly BSD, macOS and Solaris.
The project is fiscally sponsored by Hack Club, a US 501(c)(3) nonprofit, since March 2024.
The page links to a changelog and to FOSDEM 2016 and 2018 talks by the author.
summary.summary: This is the project homepage for htop, an interactive, text-mode process viewer that runs in console or X terminals and depends on ncurses. The page states that htop became cross-platform in version 2.0 and lists the operating systems current releases support. It also covers donation support via Hack Club as fiscal sponsor, points to the changelog for release details, and embeds links to the author's FOSDEM 2016 and 2018 talks. The page is a short project overview rather than a usage tutorial.
